info.title: Costfluent Public API
info.description:
The Costfluent Public API reads the cost a workspace holds and manages what is built on it: providers and custom provider uploads, cost reports, saved filters, dashboards and folders, segments, tags and virtual tags, budgets, cost alerts and report notifications, anomalies, exchange rates, workspaces, and the account's entitlement and metered usage.

Every request carries an API token in the `Authorization` header; [Authentication](/api/authentication) explains the organization and workspace tokens and what each may reach. Requests and responses are JSON ([Data formats](/api/formats)); lists are paginated ([Pagination](/api/pagination)), errors share one shape ([Errors](/api/errors)), and every token has a request budget ([Rate limits](/api/rate-limits)).

ApiTokenAuth.description: Costfluent API token beginning with cf_org_ or cf_ws_. A cf_ws_ workspace token acts in its own workspace only: lists and cost totals cover that workspace, naming another workspace answers 403, and organization-level operations need a cf_org_ organization token.
